The lion 's mane jellyfish ( Cyanea capillata ) , also known as the giant jellyfish or the hair jelly , is the largest known species of jellyfish .
The lion 's mane jellyfish ( Cyanea capillata ) , also known as the giant jellyfish or the hair jelly , is the largest known species of jellyfish .
Its range is confined to cold , boreal waters of the Arctic , northern Atlantic , and northern Pacific Oceans .
It is common in the English Channel , Irish Sea , North Sea and in western Scandinavian waters south to Kattegat and Øresund
